title: Qt: Fix leaks in RTP Stream Dialog sorting and copying
description:
Any time rtpstream_info_calculate() is called, there has to be
a matching rtpstream_info_calc_free() to avoid leaking.

commits_data.message:
Qt: Fix leaks in RTP Stream Dialog sorting and copying

Any time rtpstream_info_calculate() is called, there has to be
a matching rtpstream_info_calc_free() to avoid leaking.
